summary: Reject: this is drifting into a wooden shutter/door. The reference has closely spaced uniform narrow slats across the full panel, while a large left section is nearly plain and the remaining slats are fewer/wider. Rear lock/handle-like hardware is also invented. Regenerate the full-width architectural slat pattern with only plain rear support battens.

issues.problem: Substantial left portion lacks the repeated slats; overall spacing/count differs strongly from the defining reference pattern.
Unrequested handle/lock-like details make the wall panel read as a door.
